annotation.kind: faithful reconstruction of equations (3.17), (3.20), and Remark 4 with algorithm transcripts, condition (3.16), inverse-linked condition numbers, and explicit first-order remainder semantics

assumptions: The dimension n is positive; A and a fixed nonidentity right preconditioner MR are nonsingular with certified actual inverses; b is nonzero and xExact solves A*xExact=b.
Each algorithm transcript records a positive iteration k<=n, the MGS upper-Hessenberg relation, the perturbed MGS/Givens least-squares problem, and the fixed-preconditioner basis applications.
The basis applications satisfy the Frobenius perturbation model (3.14), products with A satisfy the Appendix-C componentwise model, and rhoAR is the exact ratio (3.15) with positive denominator.
Both right and flexible runs satisfy every term of condition (3.16), including the um*etaR*kappa(MR) term for flexible GMRES.
Appendix-C/D certificates give perturbation-linked source contributions, their individual normalized bounds, an exact error decomposition, and a remainder second order in the condition-(3.16) scale.
All modeled quantities are real, so exceptional floating-point values and range failures are outside the model.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p19_t3_right_flexible_attainable_forward_error {n : Nat} {iota : Type*} {l : Filter iota} [l.NeBot] (system : P19FixedRightSystem n) (right : P19RightTheorem33Execution system l) (flexible : P19FlexibleTheorem34Execution system l) : (exists k, k=right.run.keyDimension and 0<k and k<=n and right first-order bound (3.17)) and (exists k, k=flexible.run.keyDimension and 0<k and k<=n and flexible first-order bound (3.20)) and (forall t, right envelope at the right-run parameters = flexible-form envelope at those parameters + um*etaR*kappa2(MR))
formal_statement.plain_language: Right and fixed-preconditioner flexible MGS-GMRES each attain their complete conditional normalized first-order forward-error bound at a possibly different iteration no larger than n, and the displayed right bracket has exactly the preconditioner-reapplication term absent from the flexible bracket.

informal_proof: For each execution, use the exact Appendix-C/D error decomposition and the Euclidean triangle inequality, divide by the nonzero exact-solution norm, apply the separately certified source bounds, and retain the normalized remainder as second order in the condition-(3.16) scale. Expanding the two source brackets then identifies the right-only um*etaR*kappa(MR) term.
informal_statement: The complete conditional attainable-forward-error bounds (3.17) and (3.20), together with Remark 4's exact identification of the right-only preconditioner-reapplication term.
